name: skillshelf
description: See the Claude Code skills on this computer and switch them on or off from the chat.
long_description:
Ask Claude "show my skills" and get a card listing every Claude Code skill on this computer: your personal skills, your projects' skills and the ones that came with plugins. Each one has an on/off switch and, when Skillshelf has read its code, a colour-coded safety badge. You can also report a skill whose output was slop.

Switching changes only Claude Code's own skillOverrides setting (~/.claude/settings.json, or a project's .claude/settings.local.json), and keeps a backup of the previous file. Nothing is deleted. Changes take effect in new Claude Code sessions, including the desktop app's Code tab.

Everything runs on your computer. The only thing sent anywhere is a slop report, and then only the skill's Skillshelf id and the reason you pick.

tools.name: show_my_skills

projects.description: Projects whose own skills (.claude/skills) you also want to see and switch. Your personal and plugin skills show without this.
